prompt: Find the slope of the line through $(0, 10)$ and $(5, 0)$.
hint: The line goes DOWN from left to right, so expect a negative slope.

hints.text: The line goes DOWN from left to right, so expect a negative slope.

alternativeExplanations.title: Downhill stairs
steps: From $(0,10)$ to $(5,0)$ you drop $10$ while walking $5$ across.
Each step across drops you $2$: the slope is $-2$.
